Hi team — reviewed NexSight's materials. I approve a conditional temporary credit increase, subject to the following:

- Conditions for approval:
  1) Signed DocuSign credit agreement from NexSight (standard terms attached on DocuSign link).
  2) Redwood to issue invoices Net60. For the first two invoices of the pilot we'll run accelerated monitoring and may require payment faster if alerts trigger.
  3) A credit hold will be enacted if invoices are >60 days overdue beyond one cycle.
  4) VAT handling: we will apply reverse-charge wording to EU B2B invoices if the VAT number validates. Finance will include the EU-specific note on the invoice.

- Limits and duration: temporary credit cap €60,000 for 90 days starting from the first pilot invoice. After 90 days we'll reassess and either convert to standard credit terms or require prepayment until procurement completes.
